# MelonCactus Industrial Intelligence

MelonCactus is an industrial intelligence practice operated by GFNI in Enschede, Netherlands. It supports defined technical, commercial and strategic decisions using lawfully accessible public sources. Findings distinguish direct observations, company claims, assessment, inference and unknowns. The published example cases are fictional.
